# 00000002287

**English.** Definition: An entropy martingale comes from the minimal measure change generated by relative entropy. Conjecture: The expectation of the variation process of an entropy martingale is the supremum of the initial relative entropy, attained; and the variation expectation equals exactly the initial relative entropy with no residual term (entropy martingale variation).

**中文。** 定义：熵鞅(相对熵生成的极小测度变换)。猜想：熵鞅的变差过程的期望为初始相对熵的上确界且达到(熵鞅变差)；且变差期望恰好等于初始相对熵无剩余项。
